Chloe Moffat, a 26-year-old Treasury assistant, took her life after being ambushed in an unnotified disciplinary meeting regarding confidential office chatter, without written policy protections.

The defensive corporate reflex to frame systemic negligence as an isolated misunderstanding while avoiding immediate accountability.

Confusing WHAT (bureaucratic box-ticking) with WHO (the vulnerable human employee).

A structural bait-and-switch: institutional self-protection masquerading as welfare review.

By prioritizing opaque punitive protocols over transparent communication, management weaponized fear. Instead of fostering psychological safety, institutional opacity isolated a terrified worker.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Net negative will forces drive systemic collapse.

The Unavoidable Lie: Standard corporate fact-finding meetings are benign procedural necessities.
